youtube.title: Why the Airplane Black Box Is Orange 🟠 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Flight recorders, called black boxes, hold cockpit voice recordings and flight data. They are built to survive crash forces of about 3,400 times gravity and are painted bright international orange with reflective strips so investigators can find them in wreckage, forests, snow or the sea.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.
